description: This header provides utility functions for CLI11-based command-line interface parsing, including adding options, subcommands, handling option aliases, and converting string inputs to various types, with special support for optional and enum types.

methods.name: get_first_option_name
methods.description: Extracts the first option name from a comma-separated list of option names.

methods.name: add_subcommand
methods.description: Adds a subcommand to a CLI11 application if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_option
methods.description: Adds or replaces an option in the CLI11 application, supporting multiple parameters.

methods.name: add_option (bool specialization)
methods.description: Specialized version for boolean options, capturing default value as 'true' or 'false'.

methods.name: add_option_function
methods.description: Adds an option with a custom callback function to the application.

methods.name: add_option_cell
methods.description: Adds an option that handles a list of strings (cell) to the application.

methods.name: lexical_cast
methods.description: Converts a string to an optional typed value.

methods.name: add_auto_enum_option
methods.description: Adds an enum option that can accept 'auto' or integer values, stored in an optional parameter.
